value.name: Rosa sends detox log instructions
value.description: Asha receives a message from Rosa telling her to check the detox center's admission logs for involuntary holds because those are hidden from general inquiries.
evidence: Asha's jaw buzzed once with another message from Rosa
the words sat plain on the glass: check the detox center's admission logs specifically for involuntary holds, they hide those from general inquiries.

value.name: Asha realizes Claire has hidden knowledge
value.description: Asha silently recognizes that Claire has been carrying the significance of the word involuntary for longer than a few nights and will need to hear it spoken aloud.
evidence: she understood she would have to use it out loud when the next call connected, in this room, with Claire close enough to hear it spoken into a stranger's ear.
the word involuntary was now the second word Rosa had handed her tonight that Claire had been carrying alone for longer than three nights

value.name: Hospital confirms no psychiatric transfer
value.description: Asha gets confirmation from the hospital clerk that there has been no transfer to any psychiatric unit since Thursday.
evidence: When the hospital clerk came back to confirm no transfer to any psychiatric unit since Thursday

value.name: Asha ends hospital call
value.description: Asha thanks the hospital clerk and hangs up, closing off that line of inquiry.
evidence: Asha thanked her and ended the call
one door had just closed without anything having come through it

value.name: Asha calls detox center
value.description: Asha dials the detox center's main line to ask about admission logs for Marcus Devereaux.
evidence: She pulled up the detox center's main line, dialed

when the intake worker answered she asked, in the same flat register she had used for admissions, whether they could check their admission logs for any involuntary holds under the name Marcus Devereaux since Thursday night, spelling the surname once.

value.name: Claire reacts to involuntary hold
value.description: Claire remains silent but visibly reacts when Asha says involuntary, signaling the term has personal significance.
evidence: Across the table Claire's hands stayed folded in her lap, but her chin came up a fraction at the word involuntary
the small movement of a person hearing a thing said out loud
